desc: Add a volatility filter: only enter long when current realized volatility is below its 20-period SMA.
Add a volume confirmation filter: only enter long when current volume exceeds its 20-period SMA.
Add rising SMA50 filter to entry: only enter long when the 50-period SMA is increasing.
Add low volatility regime filter: only enter long when current realized volatility is below its 30-period SMA.
Add trend filter: only enter when the 20-period Donchian high exceeds the 50-period SMA.
Add ADX trend filter to entry: only enter long when ADX(14) > 20
